COD.rationale: Content (red) identified with explicit presentation coordinates and a separate origin/status entry for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: The report names specific content attributes (color) with coordinate sets for identified referents.

D.rationale: Origin/provenance metadata is recorded separately from the content coordinate listing for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented (coordinates) and the grid orientation.
